text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I thought I heard piacevole musica 
coming from this direction...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Is this your ensemble? Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If so... benisssssimo! I would absolutely 
love to have another!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want to play it together. A symphony of 
our souls—!
